name: Crop and animal production, hunting and related service activities
notes: Labour (L) = compensation of employees (D1, GBP 3,870m) plus GBP 2,783m of the industry's mixed income (the self-employed's income): section A's labour share of income (44.5%, uk-labour-share) times mixed income of GBP 6,259m. Mixed income by section is back-solved (GOS = D1 x (1 / labour share - 1); mixed income = GOS & MI - GOS) and spread over the section's industries pro rata to their gross operating surplus and mixed income. That spread is an assumption (Claude, 2026-10-06). Capital (K) = gross value added - L, so K includes taxes less subsidies on production (GBP 182m).

Energy, materials and services (E, M, S) sort this industry's 2023 intermediate use at purchasers' prices by product: energy = coal, crude oil and gas & metal ores (B06 & B07), refined petroleum, electricity, gas and steam; crude and refined products bought by refining and chemicals, and oil and gas bought by oil and gas extraction, count as materials; all other goods (CPA sections A, B, C) are materials; everything else is services. This is Claude's rule, not an ONS or BEA classification; no UK published E/M/S exists to compare with. Weak spots: B06 & B07 mixes oil and gas with metal ores; D352_3 includes steam and air conditioning; B09 mining support and C33 repair services count as goods.

Labour figures are ASHE 2023 revised, all employees, gross annual pay (tax year to April 2023, employees in the same job for the whole year; this covers 22,783 thousand jobs against 27,645 thousand in the April pay-period tables). Jobs are rounded to the thousand and are indicative, not headcount. The ASHE wage bill (jobs x mean annual pay) is a sample-based figure that runs well below national-accounts compensation of employees, so the two are not expected to match.

Occupation tables are for the whole SIC section A, not for this industry alone (ASHE Table 29 has sections only): 5 of 26 two-digit occupation groups are published, covering 62% of the section's annual-pay jobs. Withheld cells (CV above 20%, or disclosive) are null, never zero, so occupation totals on the page are lower bounds. Supervisory = SOC 2020 major group 1 (sub-major groups 11 and 12); nonsupervisory = all other sub-major groups.

College / non-college split uses ONS CALI pay shares for the industry group ABDE (Agriculture forestry and fishing; Mining and quarrying; Electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply; Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities), 2023: degree or higher (qualification levels HQ5 + HQ6) = 36.2% of the group's pay; HQ4 (higher education below degree) counts as non-college. Applied to this industry's L as an assumption that every industry in the group has the group's mix.

Carbon: ONS industry group(s) 1 cover this industry exactly (no apportioning). 2023, residence basis, direct (scope 1) emissions only, IPCC AR5 weights; households' own emissions are not in any industry. Fluorinated gases are the published HFC, PFC, SF6 and NF3 cells ([low] cells are blank in the source, so this can be slightly short).

capital.basis_name: Crop and animal production, hunting and related service activities
capital.basis_note: Stocks are ONS industry A01 (Crop and animal production, hunting and related service activities), which is this industry. Investment is ONS GFCF industry "01". Depreciation published only for CAPSTK industry A (A01, A02, A03); the rate shown is that group's depreciation divided by the group's net stock, and no depreciation amount is shown for this industry.
